items.title: George Wein — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Louie Lorillard who backed it could say, 'Look what I did; I put on this great festival; it didn't cost me a dime.'

ctx.x: Did you have anybody to turn to for advice as you found your way in these early days?

No. We were doing something that had never been done before. And the problem was we didn't know we were making history. We didn't archive it correctly. We didn't know, we were just worried about, you know, if we made it this year … a few dollars, Can we do it next year. That's all. We had no backers and no support. Louie Lorillard at the beginning but after that, starting in1962, I had nobody with me.
Before we get to Newport, you had a few other starts and beginnings. The very first club I think you opened was The Douxce Jazz? Le Jazz Douxce? [sic]
